lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns and 5-6 horizontal rows, forming a semi-regular 2D grid posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light pixels on top and shadow beneath, extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of faint, high-luminance blobs is visible, primarily clustered towards the posterior and basal margins of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 6-8 elongated, high-contrast objects (commensal remoras) is visible attached to or swimming in close proximity to the ventral-posterior region.
